主要内容: On May 12, 2015, Insperity, Inc. announced that its Chairman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer, Mr. Sarvadi, established a new structured, prearranged trading plan to sell a portion of his beneficially owned shares of Insperity common stock over a six-month period in accordance with Rule 10b5-1 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The plan allows Mr. Sarvadi to sell a maximum of 154,500 shares at predetermined stock prices ranging from $53.60 to $70.10. These shares represent approximately 9% of his current common stock holdings. The plan was initiated during the company’s open window for insider transactions. Rule 10b5-1 permits the implementation of a written plan for selling stock at times when insiders are not in possession of material nonpublic information, and allows them to sell stock on a regular basis and in a non-discretionary manner, regardless of any subsequent material nonpublic information they receive.
